title: undidR
text: undidR package implements difference--differences unpoolable data (UNDID); framework enables estimation average treatment effect treated (ATT) data different silos poolable. UNDID allows staggered common adoption inclusion covariates. addition, undidR also implements randomization inference (RI) procedure difference--differences described MacKinnon Webb (2020) calculate RI p-values. overview undidR framework: Schematic UNDID framework. following sections detail examples implementing undidR three stages staggered common adoption scenarios.

title: undidR
text: calling create_init_csv() silo names must specified along corresponding treatment times. Consequently, silos_names vector must length treatment_times vector. dates must entered date format. see valid date formats within undidR package call undid_date_formats(). Covariates may specified calling either create_init_csv() calling create_diff_df() via covariates parameter. choice weights also set initialization stage. options weights one : "none", "diff", "att", "". options describes levels weights applied. "diff" option uses weights based number observations (treated untreated) associated contrast (difference) silo. weights used computing subaggregate ATTs differences. counts observations recorded stage two kept n column diff_df CSV files. Likewise, number observations treatment time stored n_t column. “att” weighting option uses number post-treatment observations treated silos associated subaggregate ATT weights computing aggregate ATT subaggregate ATTs.

title: undidR
code: # First, an initializing CSV is created detailing the silos # and their treatment times. Control silos (here, 73 and 46) # should be labelled with "control". init <- create_init_csv(silo_names = c("73", "46", "71", "58"),                         start_times = "1989",                         end_times = "2000",                         treatment_times = c("control", "control",                                             "1991", "1991")) #> init.csv saved to: /tmp/RtmpUBe3LX/init.csv init #>   silo_name start_time end_time treatment_time #> 1        73       1989     2000        control #> 2        46       1989     2000        control #> 3        71       1989     2000           1991 #> 4        58       1989     2000           1991  # After the initializing CSV file is created, `create_diff_df()` # can be called. This creates the empty differences data frame which # will then be filled out at each individual silo for its respective portion. init_filepath <- normalizePath(file.path(tempdir(), "init.csv"),                                winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE) empty_diff_df <- create_diff_df(init_filepath, date_format = "yyyy",                                 freq = "yearly", weights = "both") #> empty_diff_df.csv saved to: /tmp/RtmpUBe3LX/empty_diff_df.csv empty_diff_df #>   silo_name treat common_treatment_time start_time end_time weights #> 1        73     0                  1991       1989     2000    both #> 2        46     0                  1991       1989     2000    both #> 3        71     1                  1991       1989     2000    both #> 4        58     1                  1991       1989     2000    both #>   diff_estimate diff_var diff_estimate_covariates diff_var_covariates #> 1            NA       NA                       NA                  NA #> 2            NA       NA                       NA                  NA #> 3            NA       NA                       NA                  NA #> 4            NA       NA                       NA                  NA #>   covariates date_format   freq  n n_t anonymize_size #> 1       none        yyyy 1 year NA  NA             NA #> 2       none        yyyy 1 year NA  NA             NA #> 3       none        yyyy 1 year NA  NA             NA #> 4       none        yyyy 1 year NA  NA             NA

title: undidR
text: second stage function, undid_stage_two(), creates two CSV files. first filled portion differences data frame respective silo. second captures mean (mean residualized specified covariates) outcome variable start_time end_time intervals freq. returned undid_stage_two() list two data frames can accessed suffixes $diff_df $trends_data, respectively. order accommodate silos might stringent data sharing policies, option anonymize_weights (defaults FALSE) second stage. selected, round counts n column (trends data diff matrix) well n_t column closest value anonymize_size (defaults 5). undid_stage_two() looks covariates based spelled empty_diff_df.csv file. means silos may rename covariate columns.

title: undidR
text: third stage undidR produces aggregate ATT estimate, standard errors, p-values, well group level ATT estimates staggered adoption. case staggered adoption group level ATTs can either grouped silo (agg = "silo"), treatment time (agg = "g"), treatment time every time period treatment started (agg = "gt"), , "gt" aggregation can separated silo agg = "sgt". also option aggregate time since treatment agg = "time". undid_stage_three() returns object class UnDiDObj four S3 methods: summary(), print(), coef(), plot(). summary() plot() likely useful. plot() method UnDiDObj, can specify event parameter event = TRUE order produce event study plot. can specify confidence intervals event study plot ci (defaults 0.95) window want observe event study plot can restricted setting event_window = c(start, end) start end numeric values describing periods treatment time. plot() method also inherits standard parameters normally used plot(). , can access diff matrix used compute subaggregate ATTs aggregate ATT UnDiDObj$diff. Likewise, can access trends data UnDiDObj$trends.

title: Difference-in-Differences with Unpoolable Data
text: undidR package provides framework implementing difference--differences unpoolable data (UNDID) developed Karim, Webb, Austin, Strumpf (2024). UNDID designed estimate average treatment effect treated (ATT) settings data different silos pooled together (potentially reasons confidentiality). package supports common staggered adoption scenarios, well optional inclusion covariates. Additionally, undidR incorporates randomization inference (RI) procedure, based MacKinnon Webb (2020), calculating p-values UNDID ATT. See image overview undidR framework:

code: undid_stage_three(   dir_path,   agg = "g",   weights = "both",   covariates = FALSE,   notyet = FALSE,   nperm = 999,   verbose = 100,   check_anon_size = FALSE,   hc = "hc3",   only = NULL,   omit = NULL,   max_attempts = 100 )

title: Computes UNDID results — undid_stage_three
text: dir_path character specifying filepath folder containing filled diff df CSV files. agg character specifies aggregation methodology computing aggregate ATT case staggered adoption. Options : "silo", "g", "gt", "sgt", "time", "none". Defaults "g". "silo" computes subaggregate ATT silo, "g" computes subaggregate ATT unique treatment time, "gt" computes subaggregate ATT unique treatment time & post-treatment period pair, "sgt" computes subaggregate ATT treatment time & post-treatment pair, separated silo, "time" computes subaggregate ATTs grouped time since treatment, "none" compute subaggregate ATTs, rather computes aggregate ATT directly differences. weights string, determines weighting methodologies used. Options : "none", "diff", "att", "". Defaults weighting choice specified filled diff CSV files. covariates logical value (either TRUE FALSE) specifies whether use diff_estimate column diff_estimate_covariates column filled diff df CSV files computing ATTs. notyet logical value declares -yet-treated differences treated silos used controls computing relevant sub-aggregate ATTs. Defaults FALSE. nperm Number random permutations treatment assignment use calculating randomization inference p-value. Defaults 999. verbose numeric value (NULL) toggles messages showing progress randomization inference every verbose iterations. Defaults 100. check_anon_size logical value, TRUE displays silos enabled anonymize_weights argument stage two, respective anonymize_size values. Defaults FALSE. hc Specify heteroskedasticity-consistent covariance matrix estimator (HCCME) used. Options 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 ("hc0", "hc1", "hc2", "hc3", "hc4"). character vector silos include. Defaults NULL. omit character vector silos omit. Defaults NULL. max_attempts numeric value. Sets maximum number attempts find new unique random permutations randomization inference procedure. Defaults 100.

title: undidR 3.0.0
text: Added new aggregation methods staggered adoption: "sgt", "time", "none". "sgt" computes subaggregate ATTs treatment-time post-treatment period pair, separated silo. "time" computes subaggregate ATTs grouped time since treatment. "none" skips subaggregate ATT computation directly computes aggregate ATT underlying differences. undid_stage_three() now returns object class UnDiDObj, providing unified S3 interface. Added S3 methods: print(), summary(), coef(), plot(). Added support event study plots via plot() method UnDiDObj objects. Added randomization inference p-values subaggregate ATTs. Fixed miscalculation jackknife standard errors p-values. Expanded weighting options ATT computation: "none", "diff", "att", "". "diff" applies weights computing subaggregate ATTs. "att" applies weights aggregating subaggregate ATTs. "" applies weighting stages. "none" disables weighting entirely.
